newsitem.title: UK: RESEARH ALERT - CSFB caution on Wintherthur.
newsitem.headline: RESEARH ALERT - CSFB caution on Wintherthur.

text.p: CS First Boston reiterated its "buy" rating on Wintherthur Insurance Co on Thursday but also recommended investors take profits in view of its recent strong share price performance.
Kishore Banger, an analyst at CSFB, said: "The underlying trend looks positive, but this recent exceptional price rally means it presents a very good opportunity for investors to take some profits."
Shares in Wintherthur slipped 22 Swiss francs to trade at 1,027 by 1220 GMT.

On Wednesday the company saw its stock leap to an all-time high of 1,053 francs on news that Thomas Wellauer was to take over from Peter Spaelti as chief executive at the end of 1997. The announcement was seen as positive by the market and analysts alike.

"Overall, given the shares' excellent performance, and coupled with the fact that the shares are trading above their estimated fair value price of 940 Swiss francs, we recommend investors take profits," Banger said in a research note.
